items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue existing report-only finance reconciliation. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the $4.92 is not site-attributable. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 is $928.5425623 across 5,097 calls with 229 errors, but it is not period-matched to the revenue evidence. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, labor, commitments, and forecasts are unknown because matching-period cost records, budget ceilings, and an approved learning threshold are absent. Do not extrapolate one-day revenue or September AI cost, or treat clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, shipped items, or operational outcomes as financial performance. Continue only the existing reconciliation of the 18 named tracking rows plus the aggregate row against matching-period revenue and complete cost fields; preserve unknowns as unknown.
